findings.issue: Kernel completed state binds only request/returned response, while Response does not retain its original epoch or reject clones. A clone returned as a middleware substitute still passes forRequest and can complete the epoch, while its preparation guard retains the original response. WeakMap values retain the response strongly and response retains its request, keeping the weak key alive and retaining request/projection/authority graphs in a long-lived process.
findings.required_fix: Bind exact original epoch/object with clone refusal and no public substitute; retain response weakly in the registry, release completed/failed request entries without strong key cycles.
findings.control: Genuine clone substitution cannot release; old-request epoch cannot be re-earned by rehandle/substitution; dropped request/response graph collects; ordinary native send positive.
findings.status: Present in immutable485. Parent reports genuine old47 controls reproduce clone/retention failures; later preserved three-file patch is not reviewed/approved by this artifact.

findings.issue: requireUnchanged re-materializes cookies to compare candidateHeaders. Native Cookie::__toString computes Max-Age using time(); an unchanged session cookie crossing a wall-second during original closure can differ and falsely refuse healthy output.
findings.required_fix: Materialize emission strings once before proof and compare stable raw header/cookie facts during guards, without a renewed time-dependent serialization. Keep all user-capable conversions before final proof.
findings.control: Genuine initialized HTTP/session cookie with real delayed decrypt/source callback spanning a wall-second must still release within original deadline; actual cookie/header mutation still refuses.
findings.status: Static ordinary-runtime path established from installed typed native Cookie; not a reproduced run or attribution for current failure markers.

findings.issue: Sign out is disabled while busy and returns while pending, so it cannot perform the required abort/clear transition. Its eventual redirect lacks original render/generation ownership. Public search timeout only aborts and leaves pending/busy owned until an unresolved operation settles.
findings.required_fix: Allow sign-out to synchronously erase/abort current work; scope its completion/redirect to its original lifecycle and handle failure. Public search timeout must locally settle ownership/busy state and invalidate late results independently of transport acknowledgement.
findings.control: Sign-out during pending private request clears and aborts; later old-scope logout completion cannot redirect fresh scope. Abort-ignoring public search timeout unlocks controls and rejects late results.
findings.status: Concrete source paths; reviewer executed no frontend controls.
